summary: Phase C - Leaderboard fully validated. Backend: 17/18 pytest passing (1 skipped due to /api/sessions endpoint not existing for the manual volume cross-check; the leaderboard's own volume aggregation shape and ordering are verified). Frontend: All UI flows working as specified - /leaderboard route renders 'RANGLISTE' H1, scope toggle (Freunde/Global) switches data, metric pills (Workouts/Volumen/Streak) toggle properly, period chips correctly HIDE when Streak is active and SHOW for workouts/volume, gold/silver/bronze medal icons appear for top-3 with plain rank number for rank 4+, DU badge shown on self row, progress bars rendered, sticky-you correctly absent when user is in rows. Friends page shows the two CTAs (CHALLENGES + RANGLISTE) side-by-side and 'RANGLISTE' CTA navigates to /leaderboard. The `you` contract is honored across all metric/scope combinations.

action_items: OPTIONAL/cosmetic: Fix German typo 'Domiere' -> 'Dominiere' in /app/frontend/src/pages/Leaderboard.jsx line 69 subtitle.
critical_code_review_comments: leaderboard.py - clean implementation: aggregation pipelines exclude _id correctly, ObjectId not leaked. Async/await used properly throughout.
Pydantic Query patterns on metric/period/scope/limit return 422 correctly for invalid values - good validation.

Streak global pre-filter (_global_streak_candidates) bounds to 200 candidate users with workout in last 7d - reasonable cost limit; consider documenting that streaks longer than the active-in-7d window are computed (calculate_streak still walks full session history per candidate).
Lazy import of calculate_streak inside the function is good to avoid circular import with routers/sessions.

you contract: when user is in friends scope but has no workouts the code sets you_value=0.0 immediately without computing - this is correct (workouts/volume only) but for streak in friends scope where user dropped out (current_streak=0), this still yields 0 which is the intended behavior.
Frontend Leaderboard.jsx is single-file (~230 lines) and self-contained - good size, no DRY issues, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via api client.
data-testid coverage is excellent on Leaderboard and Friends pages.
